dialogues.speaker: Check Note
dialogues.text: (Citlali, we found the books you were looking for. You were sleeping when we got here and we didn't want to wake you.)

dialogues.speaker: Check Note
dialogues.text: (Maybe drink a little less next time, eh?)

dialogues.speaker: Citlali's Bedroom
dialogues.text: (The faint sound of Citlali snoring comes from within.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Was she drinking again last night? Paimon thinks we should leave the books on the table. She wouldn't want us to wake her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone sent me to find a couple of books...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the books that Citlali wants to Kuroda.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: The first edition of "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power" and the limited deluxe edition of "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?"...

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: I must say, your friend clearly knows a thing or two. In terms of collection value, nothing the Yae Publishing House is currently putting out can rival the books you're after.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: To think I'm not acquainted with such a discerning reader... Truly regrettable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are they still available?

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: You won't find either of them on the open market, and certainly not in storage. Every copy was snapped up long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: However, I do happen to have a copy of each...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can pay you for them.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: No, no. These books would be far better off in your friend's possession, someone who can appreciate their true worth.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Knowing that, I'd be more than happy to give them to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Can I just put them here?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should probably write a message. Citlali might not even notice them in all this mess.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Paimon finds a piece of paper and thinks for a moment before writing a note.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali's Bedroom
dialogues.text: (The faint sound of Citlali snoring comes from within.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe
dialogues.text: (This light novel is sitting quietly on the table in pristine condition. Its new owner clearly hasn't been able to bring herself to read it, choosing to simply admire it instead. The area has been intentionally wiped clean, with not even so much as a speck of dust around it.)
